execution_law.rule: When something fails: diagnose, preserve evidence, recover or route around, bounded retries, keep going until it works with real evidence. FAILED in a checkpoint = that attempt failed and the next attempt is underway; never objective abandoned.
execution_law.honesty: Nothing is reported as working until its durable evidence has been inspected. Persistence of effort, not fabrication of results.
execution_law.morning: Anything still not working at morning is reported as the first remaining broken step with full evidence of what was tried: never a quiet failure, never a false success.
